  "phoneNote": "The framed introduction pushes the flowers below the first screen, leaving floristry tools rather than a bouquet as the first visible image.",
  "desktopNote": "The distinctive typography and framing work, but the dominant tools photograph and oversized founding year give secondary content too much visual weight.",

  },
  "fixes": [
    "Make the bouquet the main hero image and shorten the phone introduction so flowers are clearly visible above the fixed bar; use a different, relevant image for the gift section.",
    "Make calling to order the primary desktop hero action, with services as a secondary link rather than giving gift baskets the strongest emphasis.",
    "Reduce the oversized founding year and excessive desktop section padding, and tighten the phone hero's decorative spacing to create a more consistent rhythm."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone and desktop: the same bouquet photograph is repeated in the hero inset and the gift section."
  ]
}
